name: rai-claude-mods
description: Five free Claude Code mods by Rapple AI: plain-English Simple Mode, plan usage tracking, one-click context handoff, priority inbox alerts and Codex-powered computer use.

plugins.name: simple-mode
plugins.description: A plain-English checklist of what Claude is doing, one-line tool rows you can expand, and a two-line summary at the end of every reply. /simple toggles it.

plugins.name: usage-tally
plugins.description: Your plan usage in Claude Code: session and weekly limits with reset countdowns in the status line, a /tally pane, and warnings at 75% and 90%.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: A green/amber/red context bar above the prompt with a one-click handoff note that the next chat loads automatically.

plugins.name: inbox-alerts-priority
plugins.description: Gmail, Slack and Calendar inside Claude Code, with pop-up alerts only for priority messages.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Claude thinks, Codex clicks: Claude's desktop computer use routed through the Codex app's engine, with per-app approval. Windows and macOS.
